status: Prepared only; no hosted Auth changes or successor merge authorized

proposed.confirmation: code only; generic /auth/confirm address cannot consume a token

globalExpiryScope: The single email OTP expiration setting also shortens confirmation, recovery, email-change and invitation token validity. It is not independently scoped to the two new forms.
migration: Application first. Verify the deployed /auth/confirm code form and legacy link support, then apply only the three payload fields. GET-only comparison must verify every unrelated setting, and encrypt the new configuration using the existing recovery arrangement.
security: Six-digit codes have lower entropy than eight-digit codes. Shorter expiry and unchanged provider verification/resend rate limits mitigate online guessing; no rate-limit or validation bypass. Accept previously issued eight-digit codes during transition.
verification: Local Auth with six digits/600-second expiry; code-only signup, cross-tab and separate-browser confirmation, wrong/single-use/11-minute-expired recovery, explicit password update, old confirmation URL compatibility, and private cache headers all passed.
recovery: Preserve R3/R4 and uploaded supplements. Refresh only the changed encrypted Auth configuration after approved hosted change; no repeated portable-key/offsite drill.
rollback: Keep the compatible application and restore only the exact previous three Auth values if an approved rollback is needed. Do not restore insecure grants or overwrite unrelated settings.
providerConcurrency: Actual local GoTrue admitted two simultaneous confirmation verifications for the same code/account; sequential replay was rejected. Per-tab duplicate submissions are blocked. Do not promise globally atomic single-browser consumption. No hosted reproduction or server modification performed.
